Ho Chi Minh City's must-have Treasure Bar: Super-fueled music, great value for money
Apr 2026 • Friends
Walk in and be drawn to the music! DJs have a lot of control over the scene, with progressive rhythms and level selections that go hand in hand with great sound effects, allowing people to quickly get into the atmosphere and unconsciously follow the rhythm. The overall space is both that sense of being close to each other and full of energy and tension, with a very high atmosphere throughout the night, perfect for meeting friends and relaxing.
The PG here is also impressive, not only for its bright shape but also for its natural and thoughtful service, which is comfortable to interact with without a sense of distance. Even more surprising is the level of experience, the price is quite reasonable and the value for money is really good.
If you want to experience the lively and authentic nightlife of Ho Chi Minh City, it's definitely worth a try. I'm already planning to come back next time.

Ho Chi Minh City's must-have Treasure Bar: Super-fueled music, great value for money
Apr 2026 • Friends
First of all, the music here is fantastic! The DJ knows how to mobilize the atmosphere, the selection is in great taste and the sound effects are quite striking, so people can't help but follow the rhythm as soon as they get in. The atmosphere in the store is both intimate and explosive, with that (extremely high) feeling running through the room, perfect for partying with friends.

It has to be mentioned that the PG (Promoting Girls) values here are very high and not only outstanding looking, but also professional and welcoming, making people feel at home. What surprised me most was that in such a high-quality nightlife venue, the price was very pro-folk and reasonable and the value for money was excellent.

If you want to experience Saigon's most burning and pure nightlife, KHU 13 is definitely my top pick. I will definitely be back in Ho Chi Minh City next time!
